record.hypothesis: Exclude left-padding steps from recurrent computation by packing each observed history, then scatter GRU outputs back to their original positions for aligned next-item supervision. Read inference states at the final real position. This should prevent padding-driven hidden-state drift, especially with median histories of 7–8 interactions. Preserve truncation length, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer; mirror sequence handling in the predictor.

+    def _sequence_states(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        emb = self.dropout(self.item_emb(seq))
+        batch_size, width = seq.shape
+        lengths = seq.ne(0).sum(dim=1)
+        positions = torch.arange(width, device=seq.device).expand_as(seq)
+        starts = width - lengths
+
+        # Move each left-padded history to the beginning before packing.
+        source = (positions + starts.unsqueeze(1)).clamp(max=width - 1)
+        compact = emb.gather(
+            1, source.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, self.hidden_units)
+        )
+        compact = compact * (positions < lengths.unsqueeze(1)).unsqueeze(-1)
+        packed = nn.utils.rnn.pack_padded_sequence(
+            compact, lengths.clamp(min=1).cpu(),
+            batch_first=True, enforce_sorted=False,
+        )
+        packed_out, _ = self.gru(packed)
+        compact_out, _ = nn.utils.rnn.pad_packed_sequence(
+            packed_out, batch_first=True, total_length=width,
+        )
+
+        # Restore the original alignment with positive and negative targets.
+        offsets = (positions - starts.unsqueeze(1)).clamp(min=0)
+        out = compact_out.gather(
+            1, offsets.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, self.hidden_units)
+        )
+        return out * seq.ne(0).unsqueeze(-1)

category_rationales.rationale: Pack observed histories so left padding cannot drive GRU hidden-state updates, then restore outputs to their original positions for unchanged next-item supervision. Preserve final-real-position readout, embeddings, recurrent topology, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so inference automatically uses identical sequence handling without checkpoint changes.
